messages:
Sam T: Hey everyone  first day problem: clicked the Okta invite and got an error `session state mismatch (S300)` after the first redirect. Tried clearing cookies and it just loops back to the invite page. Also when trying to enroll a passkey on macOS via Chrome I see `Unable to create credential` in the browser console. No 1Password invite either. Who should I poke?

Riley (IT): Welcome Sam! That S300 usually means the invite redirect picked up a stale session cookie from a different Okta tenant or a corp SSO extension is injecting headers. Two quick things: 1) open the invite link in a fresh Incognito window (verify no extensions), 2) try Safari or Firefox to rule out Chrome extension interference. If that fails, DM me and I'll issue a one-time magic invite link.

Sam T: Tried incognito in Chrome and still looped. Switched to Safari and the invite page progressed further but then failed at passkey enrollment. Console shows: `DOMException: The operation is insecure.`

Marco (Security): That console message often ties to extension content scripts or to strict cookie policies. Do you have "Corp SSO Helper" or a browser agent installed? Those sometimes block navigator.credentials. If so, try disabling it for the invite flow. Also confirm Device Management hasn't applied an enterprise cert that blocks WebAuthn.

Sam T: I had the Corp SSO Helper extension. Disabled it, retried in incognito  invite completed! I could finish account creation but passkey enrollment still errors in Chrome. Safari seemed to accept the passkey earlier but Okta didn't persist it.

Riley (IT): Good catch on the extension. For the passkey issue: try enrolling via Okta Verify on your phone as a passkey alternative (mobile passkeys sync back to the web flow in many cases). If you want hardware key only we can add a YubiKey later. I created ticket IT-54876 in case we need to whitelist your device session or attach a bypass token.

onboard-bot: [automated] Ticket IT-54876 created  "Okta invite S300 loop + passkey enrollment inconsistent". Assigned to Riley (IT). ETA 2h.

Nora - People Ops: Sam, I saw the account creation came through so I requested a 1Password seat (PL-1167). Vendor confirmed provisional seat, you'll get the invite in ~20 mins. In the meantime I've added you to new-hires-temp so you have calendar and docs access. Do you need repo access right away?

Sam T: Repo access later is fine. I managed to sign in after disabling that extension and using Safari for parts of the flow. Mobile Okta Verify passkey enrollment worked and now I can sign in without SMS. 1Password invite arrived and I accepted it  all set. Thanks for the fast help!

Riley (IT): Great. Follow-up: Marco and I will file a note about the Corp SSO Helper extension causing WebAuthn issues across the fleet. If you want, we can later switch you from mobile passkey to a hardware YubiKey and remove SMS fallback. Happy first day! :tada:
